```yaml
name: E2E Flow Tests

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ai_provider:
        description: 'AI Provider for E2E tests'
        required: false
        default: 'openai'
        type: choice
        options:
          - openai
          - anthropic
          - google
          - openrouter

  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'apps/web/__tests__/e2e/**'
      - 'apps/web/package.json'
      - 'packages/cli/**'
      - '.github/workflows/e2e-flows.yml'

env:
  PNPM_VERSION: 8
  NODE_VERSION: 20

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || vars.E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: inbox_zero_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Setup ngrok
        run: |
          curl -s https://ngrok-agent.s3.amazonaws.com/ngrok.asc | sudo tee /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/ngrok.asc >/dev/null
          echo "deb https://ngrok-agent.s3.amazonaws.com buster main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ngrok.list
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install ngrok
          ngrok config add-authtoken ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Start ngrok tunnel
        run: |
          ngrok http 3000 --log=stdout &
          sleep 5
          echo "NGROK_URL=$(curl -s http://localhost:4040/api/tunnels | jq -r '.tunnels[0].public_url')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup test environment
        run: |
          cd apps/web
          cp .env.example .env.test
          echo "DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/inbox_zero_test" >> .env.test
          echo "REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379" >> .env.test
          echo "NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=${{ env.NGROK_URL }}" >> .env.test
          echo "WEBHOOK_URL=${{ env.NGROK_URL }}/api/webhooks" >> .env.test
          echo "E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL=${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}" >> .env.test
          echo "E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL=${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}" >> .env.test
          echo "AI_PROVIDER=${{ github.event.inputs.ai_provider || 'openai' }}" >> .env.test

      - name: Run database migrations
        run: pnpm db:migrate --env=test

      - name: Run E2E flow tests
        run: pnpm test-e2e:flows
        env:
          CI: true
          E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
          E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}
          E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NGROK_URL: ${{ env.NGROK_URL }}
          AI_PROVIDER: ${{ github.event.inputs.ai_provider || 'openai' }}

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-test-results
          path: |
            apps/web/__tests__/e2e/results/
            apps/web/__tests__/e2e/screenshots/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Cleanup ngrok
        if: always()
        run: |
          pkill ngrok || true
```
